flora: Horsetail strobilus (cone-like spore-bearing tip, distinct scales)
Segmented stem (bamboo-like joints with dark rings)
Horsetail sapling (single upright green shoot, very straight)
Whorled leaves (close-up of thin, needle-like leaves radiating from a stem joint)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; emphasis on the repetitive, geometric segments of the stems; tactile 'waxy' texture for the green stalks; clear quadrant separation for educational study.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left: The spore-bearing tip (strobilus); Top-Right: Detailed view of a stem segment joint; Bottom-Left: A young emerging shoot; Bottom-Right: A high-detail view of the needle-like leaf whorl.
visual_logic.ground: Wet, sandy tan riverbank soil with small ripples from water recession.
visual_logic.lighting: Clear, even, bright diffused daylight to highlight the architectural structure of the plant.
